<a name="INSPECTOR_GROUPS"></a>

## INSPECTOR\_GROUPS

Inspector groups share one preview instead of owning independent configurations.

**Kind**: global constant
<a name="inspectorMaximum"></a>

## inspectorMaximum(availableWidth) ⇒

Reserve the divider and a usable preview beside the inspector.

**Kind**: global function
**Returns**: Maximum expanded inspector width; narrow screens use a drawer instead.

| Param          | Description                                   |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| availableWidth | Actual workbench content width in CSS pixels. |

<a name="resizeInspector"></a>

## resizeInspector(candidate, wasOpen, availableWidth) ⇒

Apply split-view snapping while keeping the expanded panel's content readable.

**Kind**: global function
**Returns**: Transient visibility and width; remembered width is committed separately.

| Param          | Description                                                   |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| candidate      | Raw pointer-requested inspector width, excluding the divider. |
| wasOpen        | Current snap state; a half-minimum threshold prevents jitter. |
| availableWidth | Workbench width before subtracting its divider and preview.   |

<a name="parseInspectorPreferences"></a>

## parseInspectorPreferences(stored) ⇒

Restore only valid editor preferences; malformed or unavailable storage is harmless.

**Kind**: global function
**Returns**: A complete preference object without mutating shared defaults.

| Param  | Description                                         |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| stored | JSON previously saved for this browser's inspector. |
